aliases.name: Debreceni Egyetem tud-tech park

aliases.name: Déli ipari terület

aliases.name: Akadémiakert
aliases.reason: Minor spelling/word-formation variant in the historical municipal reference inventory; the ArcGIS and selected catalogue use Akadémiakert.

aliases.name: Nagycsere
aliases.reason: The reference inventory explicitly flags Nagycserte as a transcription anomaly; the same municipal-part series and source polygons use Nagycsere. Keep the anomalous source spelling as a searchable alias, not another area.

aliases.name: Nagyerdőtölgyes
aliases.reason: The reference inventory explicitly flags this source spelling as a transcription anomaly; the source polygon and current catalogue use the ordinary tölgyes spelling.

aliases.name: Tócórét
aliases.reason: Accent-only reference transcription variant of the same named Tócó area.

aliases.name: KISZ-lakótelep
aliases.reason: The OSM named-place source explicitly has alt_name=Ifjúsági lakótelep; the municipal list itself supplies KISZ parenthetically.

aliases.name: Kenderföld
aliases.reason: Singular/plural source labels for the same local area; keep the explicitly named residential source outline rather than adding another search identity for the rough barrier cell.
